name: gaze
description: Local face detection + recognition + gaze direction. Spawns a Python server (InsightFace + Gazelle + MediaPipe) as a child process.

default_subscriptions.description: Gaze node control commands (toggle capture, switch model). Forwarded to the Python sidecar.
Rename a tracked face. Payload: {face_id, new_name}.
Merge two face IDs into one. Payload: {keep, drop}.
